CustomField.description: THE REAL PERSON who completed this item, written by the completion service. A role-named lookup to User, which the naming convention explicitly permits because API names must be unique and a bare User__c cannot be repeated. This retires the LastModifiedBy approximation that TaskSelector and TransactionTaskController both carry warnings about - LastModifiedBy names whoever last touched the row, which after any rollup or backfill is not the person who did the work.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The user who completed this item. Set automatically when the item is marked complete.
CustomField.label: Completed By
